title: Ils ne sont pas marxistes: r/LeftistsForAI, Marx's Legacy, and the Left's Lost Capacity for Internal Critique
sentence: The UK SWP lets factions exist only during the three-month pre-conference period, which is a rule built to stop a critique from persisting (background knowledge; [libcom, "Splits of the SWP"](https://libcom.org/article/splits-socialist-workers-party-britain)).

title: Ils ne sont pas marxistes: r/LeftistsForAI, Marx's Legacy, and the Left's Lost Capacity for Internal Critique
sentence: At Rimini in 1976, women asked for the proceedings to be suspended "because they wanted to meet as women." One delegate called it "a little difficult to support the Men's Revolutionary Party." The general secretary, Adriano Sofri, said "a handful of people" had treated the organization as "a sort of private property," and added: "I was wrong" ([Rimini Congress](https://libcom.org/library/d-revolutionary-left-16-rimini-congress)).
